filesNew.text: New behaviour on these boards: Keep on this device is one switch for the whole book (audiobook, ebook and the reading sync map), and a book with only an ebook sits in the Library. The Book page goes on below the files: the description, Hardcover, Mark as finished and Remove (Book: further down). The rest gives a new home to what the app does today.

syncSteps.text: The steps are those of the whole-book job that production runs. The chapter matcher of the older engine is not drawn.

activityPlace.text: Activity is a fourth place. It takes over the Downloads page, Settings, Activity and Settings, Reading sync. The phone Server board shows the top of a longer list; the desktop board shows all of it.

seriesPage.text: A series is a page, not a dialog. Its books are listed in reading order with the row used everywhere else, and each one opens its book. A book says which series it belongs to under its author. Add and the two Get switches are today’s Add selected works and its two search options.

readingRules.text: Now playing (in the first row) has two faces, Listen and Read, with the same transport. The Lyrics and Word views are gone; Reading mode (Pages or Scroll) is the first row of Appearance. Speed and the sleep timer take the place of the transport in the foot (Reader: speed). Controls only appear in the head and the foot of the page, which keep their height, so the text does not move and is never covered. The two boards "across pages" show one sentence before and after the page turns. The rules are on the Reading board at the top.

tooltipMarks.text: An info mark opens its tooltip on a tap in Play mode. Three are drawn open: on Book, on Worker and on the desktop Server board. Every text is listed on the Tooltips board.

activityStates.text: The states of Activity that were not drawn before (#458): empty, no connection, someone who is not the administrator, a failed save on this device, a queue that is Paused and a worker that is Not in use, and This device on the desktop. Paused and Not in use do not light the attention dot; a failed save on this device does, for anyone.

bookStates.text: The Book page states that were not drawn before (#460): the Hardcover page behind the Hardcover row (shelf, lists, the match, the Hardcover edition, Use Hardcover position), the same page before a match, a book that is not in the library yet with Add to library, a book with nothing yet, and a book with only a PDF (Read off, the PDF opens in another app). Where a book has no audiobook and none is on its way, its Get is the main action.

syncStates.text: The states of the Reading sync page that were not drawn before (#461): paused, cancelled, partly ready, no text matched, not available (English only), and Prepare again while the reading sync in use stays in use. When the new one matches clearly less of the text it is not used, and the one in use stays (#462). Unsynced passages come last on every state, so a long list never pushes Prepare again away.

keepStates.text: The states of Keep on this device that were not drawn before (#466). Turning it off asks once, in place, with the total size. A book is never shown as kept while a file is missing: it reads Not complete, and a save that failed has Retry and the reason. The switch can be on before any file exists. A changed recording is saved and the earlier copy stays until removed. When the device is full, or the browser has cleared Sonder's files, This device says so; a cleared device saves its kept books again by itself.

seriesStates.text: The states of the Series page that were not drawn before (#463): a series that is not saved yet, with Save series as its one action and the same sheet as Add; works without a number under Related works; the New mark on a book Hardcover added later, with Dismiss; and removing a series, which keeps its books unless the administrator also removes the books it added. A book that is not in the library is not a link; its Add opens the sheet.

shellStates.text: Discover finds books (#470): one search over the server and Hardcover, Books or Series. A result opens its Book page; a Hardcover book not on the server opens as "Not in your library" with Add to library. The last row, for the administrator, searches for a recording and makes the book from it. The Library’s one control for sort and view (#471) also holds the Hardcover shelf and list; a filter in use shows as a chip that clears it. Books with only an ebook, only a PDF or nothing yet are tiles like any other. Without a connection the shell shows one line above the player.

settingsStates.text: The Settings detail pages (#472). Each is a page with a back button; on a desktop it opens beside the list (Desktop: Settings, in the second row, shows Connections). Settings has no Reading page: Reading mode and Follow the narration are in Playback. Someone who is not the administrator has no Users and no Library and storage. Signing in, asking for an account and joining from an invite (#473) use the same parts, with no tab bar.

readerStates.text: The reader's states that were not drawn before (#468): Search and Bookmarks as pages; the sleep timer in the foot in place of the transport, as speed is; every message in the foot's lower row, with Play or Pause kept at its end (Listening from here with Undo, an error, a place saved elsewhere, an update that waits for a pause, a bookmark removed with Undo); a book with only an ebook, whose foot holds the place and a position slider; and Listen on a desktop, with the reader's head, chapters and footer.
